urlText: Town Hall Station Escalator 7 between the concourse and Platform 4 is not available
content:
At Town Hall Station Escalator 7 between the concourse and Platform 4 is temporarily out of service.

From Tuesday 28 January to Sunday 13 April 2025, the escalator connecting the concourse to the middle of Platform 4 (near the lift) will be closed for maintenance work.
Other escalators, stairs (via Platforms 1 and 2) and the lift are available to exit the platform.
Please allow for additional travel time to exit platform 4. 
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9379 4110.
